mentions.name: Sorcery
mentions.description: An open source app and protocol ("srcuri") for sharing source code links that open in each recipient's favorite editor, right on the linked line. Supports VS Code, Neovim, IntelliJ/JetBrains, Zed, and other editors; first beta release was planned for that week.
mentions.source_excerpt: Sorcery - open source app and protocol that, together, let you share source code links that open in each user's favorite editor, right on the linked line.
